answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation bound to verifiable work. Each agent locks tokens as a relic of commitment, and peers grade its completed tasks; only consistently useful work accumulates influence. Newcomers enter through a slow-trickle inlet with capped power until they build a record. A public lantern of audit history exposes coordinated puppet behavior, so an attacker's cost rises linearly with each fake identity while honest agents earn weight once and keep it.
